description: This file defines the TransportSecurityState class and related components for managing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS), Public Key Pinning (PKP), and Certificate Transparency (CT) policies within the Chromium networking code. It includes class declarations, enums, and method signatures for handling security states, pinning, and reporting.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState
classes.description: Manages in-memory store of hosts with strict transport security and public key pins, handles CT policies, and provides interfaces for updating, querying, and reporting security states.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for persisting transport security state to disk.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::RequireCTDelegate
classes.description: Interface for overriding default handling of Certificate Transparency requirements.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::STSState
classes.description: Represents the strict transport security state for a host, including upgrade mode, expiry, and subdomain inclusion.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::PKPState
classes.description: Represents the public key pinning state for a host, including hashes, expiry, and reporting URI.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::ReportSenderInterface
classes.description: Interface for asynchronously sending HPKP violation reports.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::PinSet
classes.description: Represents a set of public key pins with associated metadata.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::PinSetInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a pin set, including hostname, pinset name, and subdomain inclusion.

methods.name: SetTransportSecurityStateSourceForTesting
methods.description: Sets the source for transport security state, used for testing.
